## Game overview

- **Title:** New Life Project, v0.9.easter — by Nota Bao
- **Engine:** SugarCube
- **PC:** Josephine (female, default name "Player" overrideable, but the auto-advance settled on Josephine via the playGirl branch)
- **Genre:** sandbox lifesim with dark/sexual themes (assault, drug-buy, escalating corruption arc)
- **Loop:** click locations on a hub → activities advance `period`/time → time gates which choices are available → must pay weekly rent (£400/week to Zack) and feed/sleep cycles
- **Easter event:** v0.9.easter overlays collectible "chocolate eggs" across map nodes (Downtown, Uptown, Cafe, Park each show one). Picked up via "Pick it up" → easter<Loc> passage; tracked in `eggs` counter + `eggLocations.*` flags

## Mechanics observed

- **Time:** every action advances `period`. Sleep advances ~7 periods (full cycle). `countperiods` is the global play-time meter.
- **Travel walks:** Downtown / Uptown insert a `goingDowntown` / `goingUptown` interstitial that costs an extra period before "Arrive" puts you on the hub.
- **First-encounter narrative:** intro choices "Go further down/up the street" lead to *exploreIntro variant* descriptions (downtownExplore/uptownExplore) — these only have "Go back". The real Mall/Bar/etc. hubs only appear after the post-alley `Street` passage takes over as primary hub.
- **Rent meter:** `rent` increments daily; £400/week to Zack triggered somewhere (mechanic discovered via `rent: 0→1` after sleep cycle).
- **Easter overlay:** every public location with a "Pick it up" line drops you into `easter<Location>` then "Stand up straight" returns. Pure collectible loop, no stat cost.
- **RNG events:** `rngesus`, `luckyCasino`, `_rng` drive random encounters / outcomes (visible in pathfinder gates for keepExplore loops).

# Session 2 (Day 1-8 playthrough, full economy + relationship loop)

## Economy

- **Cafe shift "Clear tables":** £20 base + £19 tips = **£39/period**, costs 1 period. cafeCount tracks total shifts. After 5-6 shifts in a row, period maxes (6) and you're auto-kicked to Street.
- **Coffee at Cafe:** £5, drops period -1 (gain a turn), +5 lily, sets `coffeeDrunk=true` (one-time per day). Triggers Lily appearance for "Approach her".
- **Cinema ticket:** £5, advances 1 period, plays a movie scene (3 genres: Us, Time Bomb, Sex Architect — last one drops inhib + raises arousal).
- **Bar drink:** advances 1 period, +25 arousal (vibeLevel 0.075→0.2 — alcohol intoxication mechanic).
- **Quick-E Mart:** Groceries £19, Massage oil £49, Sunscreen £29, Makeup £29 (sets `makeup=true`, +5 allure when re-applied at park restroom).
- **Clothing Store:** Gym clothes £99, Bikini £199 (both £-gated; tied to gym/beach activities).
- **Electric Giant:** Phone £299, Camera £199, Laptop £599, GPS £2999 (gates: phone enables dating per FAQ; laptop unlocks `Laptop` action in bedroom).
- **Beauty Shop:** Leg wax / pussy wax / makeup / hair styling — all £-gated (prices not shown when unaffordable).
- **Massage Parlor:** "Get a massage" lowers trauma — price not visible from parlor entry.
- **Dealership:** Bike £3999, Honda £20500, Toyota £20500, Audi £31900, Hyundai £22300, BMW £36000. Bikes give bonus Street nav ("Take bike uptown/downtown").
- **Alley dealer prices (from passage source):** Fake ID £999, Aphrodisiac (+50 arousal) £1999, +10 corrupt £1999, -10 inhib £1999, -50 trauma £1999.

## Rent system (verified)

- `rent` ticks +1 per sleep (i.e. per day). Triggers `payRent` event when `rent eq 7` (weekly).
- `rentAmount` starts £400, escalates +£350 each week, capped at **£1800/week**. Schedule: w1 £400, w2 £750, w3 £1100, w4 £1450, w5+ £1800.
- If dating Zack (`$dating is "Zack"`), Zack covers rent + resets `rent` to 0.
- Otherwise: trigger lands on `[[Someone is knocking|payRent]]` link → "Pay him - £$rentAmount" or "Ask for different payment" (corrupt ≥ 60) or "Say you can't afford it" → `rentRape`.
- **Confirmed pay:** £400 → £108 leftover, rent went 7→0, rentAmount 400→750. Cafe Day 7→8 transition.

## Time/period system (full picture from `Beginning` source)

- **Day var:** $day = 1..N (Monday = 1 per `setup.DAYS = [Sunday,Monday,...]`)
- **Period var:** $period = 1..6 (`["Asleep","Early morning","Morning","Noon","Afternoon","Evening","Night"]`)
- **countperiods:** cumulative play-time meter (used for trauma/quest decay)
- **questDays:** parallel counter incrementing on sleep
- Sleep advances to period 1 of next day, +7 to countperiods.
- Many activities have period-gates: Bar/Beauty/Mall/Library/Cinema all require `period <= 5` (closed at night). Club only opens at night.
- Daily decay vars: `kitchenClean`/`zackClean` decay -25 per sleep cycle (cleaning chore mechanic).

## Mechanics catalogued

- **Coffee turn-back:** `coffeeDrunk` flag rolls daily; coffee gives -1 period (extra action) — only useful early in day.
- **Pet system:** Resting on park bench rolls `pet` object (race/gender/attribute). 10 cat breeds + male/female + 5 attributes. `pet.isFound` flag suggests catching mechanic.
- **Bike states:** `bike` (true/false) × `bikeCond` (good/bad/punctured). Bike speeds up uptown/downtown but degrades.
- **Mugged event:** rng-gated on Street if `mugged>=5` and strength ≤ 60. Steals random £217-517 (or whole purse). Strength > 60 lets you fight off.
- **Alley escalation:** `alleyCount >= 21` → kidnap event (`alleyKidnap`). `allure >= 40 && rng==1` → `alleyRape`. Same NPC also has stat-shop ("Look at his wares") and a job offer if corrupt ≥ 60.
- **Phone for dating:** Per FAQ, phone (£299 from Electric Giant) lets you contact characters. Later, dates start from a character's room.
- **Quest letters:** `questLetter1`/`questLetter2` start "unopened" — likely mail trigger after some condition.
- **Mansion arc:** `mansion`/`morrisTalk`/`constantin`/`cellarClean`/`mansionCook` form a cluster — separate progression after Street arc.
- **Mood system:** 14-key mood object (Lively, Empty, Dominant, Submissive, Sensual, Romantic, Excited, Relaxed, Impulsive, Ashamed, Critical, Embarrassed, Delirious, Despairing) — feeds NPC reactions / scene variants.
- **NSFW counters:** `masCount`/`suckCount`/`vagCount`/`assCount`/`doubCount`/`rapeCount`/`creamCount` — sex stat tracking for endings/achievements.
